title: LIC Board Approves First-Ever 1:1 Bonus Issue Since 2022 Listing
summary: LIC capitalises ₹6,325 crore from reserves to issue 1 free share for every 1 share held, doubling paid-up capital to ₹12,650 crore.

blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 LIC Board Approves First-Ever 1:1 Bonus Issue Since 2022 Listing. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: LIC Board approved a **1:1 bonus issue**, capitalizing ₹6,325 crore from reserves to double paid-up capital to ₹12,650 crore by June 12, 2026.
**Purpose**: Boost share liquidity and make stock accessible to retail investors.
**MPS (minimum public shareholding threshold for listed firms) Compliance**: Helps Govt of India (holding 96.5%) move towards SEBI's 10% minimum public shareholding norm by May 2027.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
